about: The held-out set for `hxq owner`: questions written by an agent that saw only the backlog's hxq-bugs records, never the owners' docs or the ranking, first measured after OWNER-INDEX-3's tuning and never tuned on, so it is the honest reading a ranking change must move. `owners` are the types whose answer it is (a member of one counts); `atLeast` is the floor the test holds. Never reword a question to fit a doc. Read by unit.query.OwnerParaphraseTest.

questions.question: where do I decide whether a dotted name is a field access or a package path
canonical absolute location of a file after following links, even if missing
can a closure or later call modify this variable I am reading
checking whether a block's final statement supplies the enclosing value
which declared command-line switches does each subcommand accept and how are unknown ones rejected
reading file contents and diffs at an old commit without checking it out
which names does a star import bring into scope
pool of long-lived compiler processes reused across lint runs
does this expression have side effects, so it is safe to drop or reorder
finding every place a variable or field gets assigned
which standard library functions are known to be free of side effects
